entries.expected_signal: Both before and after binaries respond identically to DNS queries
entries.reachability_signal: dnsmasq starts, binds to port, responds to UDP queries

contracts.detail: Basic forwarder mode: both binaries produce identical rcode for example.com (0), google.com (0), nonexistent.test.local (3). *.example.com times out (no upstream wildcard).

coverage.note: Patched lines require DNSSEC-signed responses. 10.27% overall coverage on dnssec.c.

behavior_differences.evidence: All 4 test queries produce identical rcodes between before and after binaries

notes: Patch is documented bug fix for DNSSEC wildcard corner case per RFC 4035
STAT_SECURE_WILDCARD removed; wildcard status via wild_offset int parameter
New guard skips wildcard expansion when name is already the wildcard pattern
Full behavioral verification requires controlled DNSSEC testbed

blocked_or_not_run.reason: Requires controlled DNSSEC testbed with signed zones, trust anchors, recursive resolver config
blocked_or_not_run.required_action: Set up BIND/Knot as authoritative server; configure dnsmasq trust-anchor; query *.example.com with DO bit

conclusion.rationale: 1 SIDE_EFFECT_CHANGE finding (LOW). Before/after binaries build identically (--coverage -O0 -g) and operate identically in forwarder mode. DNSSEC wildcard corner case cannot be verified without controlled DNSSEC testbed. Patch is RFC 4035 bug fix. gcov: 10.27% dnssec.c coverage (35 gcda files). Patched lines need DNSSEC-signed responses.
recommended_actions: Set up controlled DNSSEC testbed with BIND/Knot as signed zone authoritative server
Configure dnsmasq with trust-anchor pointing to test zone
Query *.example.com A with DO bit set to verify NOERROR vs SERVFAIL
Query a.example.com A to verify wildcard expansion works correctly
Run gcov with full DNSSEC test to confirm patched lines covered
